adhd.touches: Spawns N isolated ideation subagents (token spend), writes nothing outside scratch; scores and prunes branches

adr.touches: Writes docs/ADRs/<NNN>-<slug>.md; reads the decision context only

agent-performance-review.touches: Reads subagent_runs table; proposes (never applies) prompt/model changes

agent-teams.touches: Edits .claude/settings.json env flag and stack-config.json orchestration_mode

alias.touches: Read-only: lists the short names configured on this machine and explains where each came from; changes nothing

auto-merge.touches: Writes GitHub repo settings, rulesets, and a CI workflow via gh; gates merges on run-tests

brainstorming.touches: Text-only conversation; reads context, writes nothing, spawns nothing

carbonet.touches: Read-only environment/auth/stack checks; prints fixes, never shows secrets

carbonight.touches: Reads session diff, runs touched tests; commits only the lesson note and handoff file

claude-api.touches: Read-only reference for Claude API models, pricing, and params; writes nothing

claude-automation-recommender.touches: Reads the codebase; recommends hooks/subagents/skills, applies nothing

cloud-setup.touches: Prints a setup one-liner and click-steps; reads and writes nothing

cost-cap.touches: Writes session/day/hard-cap cost limits to stack config

cost-gate.touches: Runs a 10-row LLM sample (small spend), writes .claude/cost-projections/, blocks bulk jobs pending approval

coverage-snapshot.touches: Reads field-coverage counts before/after a bulk data run; fails loudly on regression

default-edit.touches: Edits ~/.claude/stack-defaults.json or project stack-config.json with per-change confirmation

default-settings.touches: Read-only view of global defaults, project config, and env overrides

deploy-edge.touches: Deploys a Supabase edge function with branch check, cost-log, ops checks, and smoke test

design-match.touches: Reads design prototype and screenshots, edits UI code, diffs after

dispatch.touches: Spawns a named subagent team, overriding foreman routing (token spend)

domain-mode.touches: Writes domain_mode(s) and paths to stack-config.json; enables extra review/gate rules

effort-eval.touches: METERED — runs golden tasks at multiple effort tiers plus cross-family judging; requires cost projection and approval

env-doctor.touches: Read-only checks of toolchain, env vars, creds presence, network, and project setup

eval-bump.touches: Runs eval suites and A/B comparisons (LLM spend); PRs golden-set patches only on strict improvement

foreman.touches: Reads stack-config.json, classifies tasks, routes subagent teams, surfaces approval gates

git-safety-net.touches: Reads local git state (reflog, stashes, worktrees, clones); preserves/recovers work before any cleanup

goodmorning.touches: Reads handoff, git state, CLAUDE.md, stack-config, PRs/CI; prints summary, starts no work

graphify-extract.touches: METERED — sends the corpus to a hosted LLM backend; writes graph output and .claude/graphify/receipt.json after hard-stop approval

graphify-init.touches: Creates the pinned shared venv and .gitignore entries; spends nothing, sends nothing off-machine

grill-me.touches: Text-only Socratic interrogation of a written plan; reads the plan, writes nothing

grilling.touches: Asks the user one multiple-choice question at a time; reads and writes nothing

handbook.touches: reads docs/handbook; build mode regenerates generated pages and the deck

handoff.touches: Pointer stub to /carbonight; touches nothing itself

loop-engineer.touches: Validates a loop spec against loop_policy ceiling, writes loop-state for Stop-hook cap enforcement

loop-level.touches: Writes loop_policy and cost_protection presets (L1-L4) into stack-config.json

loop-review.touches: Reads loop-runs.jsonl and Supabase loop_runs view; print-only cap proposals

mcp-cli.touches: Enumerates configured MCP servers and loads only needed tools; read-only discovery

model-audit.touches: Pulls live benchmark/pricing data, compares to model-routing.json; outputs a diff, never auto-applies

model-eval.touches: METERED — runs golden tasks across models/efforts with blind cross-family judging; cost projection required

native-settings-edit.touches: Sole writer of native settings.json — one allowlisted scalar leaf per call, atomic, deny-by-default

new-migration.touches: Writes the next forward-only migration file with RLS checklist; routes the pre-schema-change gate, never applies

operating.touches: Read-only operating guide — commands, automatic behaviors, tier/domain table, doc locations

plan.touches: Writes a plan to .claude/plans/; blocks implementation until explicit approval

pr-comments.touches: Reads reviewer/security reports, posts inline GitHub PR review comments via gh api; idempotent

publish.touches: Deploys to Cloudflare, binding Secrets Store secrets into wrangler.toml; hard-aborts on missing secret

recommend-capabilities.touches: Reads config/capability-registry.json and session context; ranks capabilities, writes nothing (internal only)

reflect.touches: Post-task retrospective — reads what was planned vs. shipped; captures lessons

review-handoff.touches: Reads all deliverable artifacts, runs consistency/gap review; blocks done-declaration until approve or revise

sensitivity.touches: Writes the project's data-sensitivity level to stack config; downgrades are safety-relevant

session.touches: Writes communication/effort/orchestration prefs to the session-state file; optionally saves as defaults

stack-config.touches: Read-first settings dashboard; single-setting writes routed through native-settings-edit only

stack-help.touches: reads the capability registry and help groups; prints only

strict-mode.touches: Toggles foreman strict mode in project config; turning off prompts for reason

suggest.touches: Reads thread context, calls recommend-capabilities, renders 3-5 suggestions; writes nothing

sweep.touches: Runs sweep scripts and renders the report; reports only, fixes nothing

team-init.touches: Creates an org admin repo from templates with reconciler Action; prints token-secret steps

team-status.touches: Reads ~/.claude/logs/subagent-runs.jsonl; shows agent usage, optional replan proposal

tier.touches: Writes the project tier (0-5), triggering capability install/removal; always safety-relevant

todo.touches: Read-only view of improvement-queue top items and handoff next steps

ultracode.touches: Session-only env/state flag raising the loop autonomy ceiling one level; not persisted

user-docs.touches: Drives the browser via MCP, dispatches user-docs-writer, writes screenshot-backed guides in docs/user/

user-docs-logic.touches: Executes real entry points under an adversarial parity gate; writes docs/user/logic/<unit>.md plus receipts

user-docs-refresh.touches: Replays Playwright docs-tests against the live app, classifies staleness, updates step text via writer

using-superpowers.touches: Read-only discipline guide routing brainstorming to /plan to code; writes nothing

validate-output.touches: Runs implemented code with representative inputs, asserts exact expected values; required for financial-code mode

value-check.touches: Runs the deterministic value-check-gate scorer (no LLM), renders docs/value/ROLLUP.md

walkthrough.touches: Asks the user per-surface checklist questions; writes finding-records via sweep_emit_finding only

stack-update.touches: Shows the staged stack update from the receipt and records a consent token; the apply itself runs in the UserPromptSubmit hook
